notes.title: A Tale for Anna released!
notes.content:
[b]Hooray! A Tale for Anna is now available on Steam![/b] ☀️

It's a colorful hidden object game based on bedtime stories the author of A Tale for Anna told his daughter Anna. It is full of original and tricky puzzles, exciting adventures and endearing characters:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521930/A_Tale_for_Anna/

A Tale for Anna will show you a mysterious world full of puzzles, magical creatures, and secrets. Enter a kingdom of enchantment and wonder as you learn the story of young Anna – the last remaining sorceress in the kingdom.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40299093/7a8db2b474e6b01ddc0246baed38f4ac4dcd880e.jpg[/img]

Explore fascinating worlds with Anna now 🌠
